arxiv-2407-05736.title: TransMA: an explainable multi-modal deep learning model for predicting properties of ionizable lipid nanoparticles in mRNA delivery
arxiv-2407-05736.creator: Kun Wu, Zixu Wang, Xiulong Yang, Yangyang Chen, Zhenqi Han, Jialu Zhang, Lizhuang Liu
arxiv-2407-05736.description: Abstract As the primary mRNA delivery vehicles, ionizable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) exhibit excellent safety, high transfection efficiency, and strong immune response induction. However, the screening process for LNPs is time-consuming and costly. To expedite the identification of high-transfection-efficiency mRNA drug delivery systems, we propose an explainable LNPs transfection efficiency prediction model, called TransMA.

arxiv-2411-09139.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Roy A. Lacey. The search for the Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD) critical end point (CEP) is a central focus in heavy-ion physics, as it provides insights into the phase structure of strongly interacting matter under extreme conditions.

arxiv-2510-05153.title: An Algorithmic Information-Theoretic Perspective on the Symbol Grounding Problem
arxiv-2510-05153.creator: Zhangchi Liu
arxiv-2510-05153.description: Abstract This paper provides a definitive, unifying framework for the Symbol Grounding Problem (SGP) by reformulating it within Algorithmic Information Theory (AIT). We demonstrate that the grounding of meaning is a process fundamentally constrained by information-theoretic limits, thereby unifying the Gödelian (self-reference) and No Free Lunch (statistical) perspectives.

arxiv-2511-11939.title: Modular GPU Programming with Typed Perspectives
arxiv-2511-11939.creator: Manya Bansal, Daniel Sainati, Joseph W. Cutler, Saman Amarasinghe, Jonathan Ragan-Kelley
arxiv-2511-11939.description: Abstract . To achieve peak performance on modern GPUs, one must balance two frames of mind: issuing instructions to individual threads to control their behavior, while simultaneously tracking the convergence of many threads acting in concert to perform collective operations like Tensor Core instructions. The tension between these two mindsets makes modular programming error prone.

pmc-10655145.title: Cognitive impairment in Chinese adult patients with type III spinal muscular atrophy without disease-modifying treatment
pmc-10655145.creator: Ying Hu, Ling Wei, Aonan Li, Tingting Liu, Yubao Jiang, Chengjuan Xie, Kai Wang
pmc-10655145.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveSpinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons in the spinal cord. It remains uncertain whether the cognitive performance of adult patients with SMA is impaired. The objective of this study was to assess the cognitive profile of adult Chinese patients with SMA and the association between clinical features and cognitive ability, particularly executive function.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 22 untreated adult patients with type III SMA and 20 healthy subjects.

pmc-11511471.title: The Power of Play: Strategies for Enhancing Development in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorders
pmc-11511471.creator: Felix-Constantin Adochiei, Simona-Narcisa Arghir, Ioana Raluca Adochiei, Florin Ciprian Argatu, George Calin Seritan, Bogdan Alexandrescu, Marco Iosa
pmc-11511471.description: The increasing prevalence of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) underscores its significant impact on individuals and the importance of early intervention. ASD affects various aspects of life, including education, emotional development, and social interactions. Besides traditional therapeutic approaches, a novel strategy incorporating digital games has been introduced.

pmc-11515794.title: Machine learning predictive models and risk factors for lymph node metastasis in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-11515794.creator: Bo Wu, Yihui Zhu, Zhuozheng Hu, Jiajun Wu, Weijun Zhou, Maoyan Si, Xiying Cao, Zhicheng Wu, Wenxiong Zhang
pmc-11515794.description: BackgroundThe prognosis of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is substantially affected by lymph node metastasis (LNM), but there are no noninvasive, inexpensive methods of relatively high accuracy available to predict LNM in NSCLC patients.MethodsClinical data on NSCLC patients were obtained from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database. Risk factors for LNM were recognized LASSO and multivariate logistic regression.

pmc-11534203.title: Genetic background of high myopia in children
pmc-11534203.creator: Urh Šenk, Bernard Čižman, Karin Writzl, Manca Tekavčič Pompe, Giuseppe Novelli, Giuseppe Novelli, Giuseppe Novelli
pmc-11534203.description: ObjectiveHigh myopia is a significant risk factor for irreversible vision loss and can occur in isolation or as a component of various syndromes. However, the genetic basis of early-onset high myopia remains poorly understood. We aimed to identify the causative genetic variants for high myopia in a cohort of Slovenian children.

pmc-12643063.title: Mechanistic basis for inhibition of the extended‐spectrum β‐lactamase GES‐1 by enmetazobactam and tazobactam
pmc-12643063.creator: Michael Beer, Philip Hinchliffe, Marko Hanževački, Christopher R. Bethel, Catherine L. Tooke, Marc W. Van der Kamp, Krisztina M. Papp‐Wallace, Robert A. Bonomo, Stuart Shapiro, Adrian J. Mulholland, James Spencer
pmc-12643063.description: β‐Lactamase‐catalysed hydrolysis is the primary form of β‐lactam antibiotic resistance in Gram‐negative bacteria. The penicillanic acid sulfone (PAS) enmetazobactam is thought to inhibit extended‐spectrum β‐lactamases (ESBLs) by fragmentation of an initial acyl‐enzyme to form an active‐site lysinoalanine cross link. We investigate interactions of enmetazobactam and its congener tazobactam with GES‐1, an ESBL with structural features of carbapenem‐hydrolysing β‐lactamases.

pmc-12654016.title: On the Hardening and Softening Behaviors of Additively Manufactured and Forged Inconel 718 Alloys Under Non-Isothermal Heat Treatments
pmc-12654016.creator: Yufeng Dong, Yetao Cheng, Jie Tang, Yubin Ke, Jie Teng, Fulin Jiang
pmc-12654016.description: During the heat treatment of nickel-based superalloy (for instance Inconel 718 alloy), the non-isothermal heating and cooling processes significantly influenced precipitation behaviors as well as the final mechanical properties. This study compared the precipitation behaviors and the resulting hardening and softening behaviors of additively manufactured and conventionally forged Inconel 718 alloys under non-isothermal heat treatment processes.

pmc-12666251.description: BackgroundIn 2010, we observed missed opportunities for earlier human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) diagnosis among people newly diagnosed with HIV attending our service. We reached out to clinical services with low HIV testing rates.Local ProblemIn the oncology service, <5% of all patients seen were tested for HIV between 2010 and 2012.

pmc-12752286.title: Survival patterns and mutation profiles in never- and light-smokers with stage IV NSCLC
pmc-12752286.creator: Kholoud Alqasem, Sakhr Alshwayyat, Salsabeel Aljawabrah, Karam Maraqa, Alaa BanyAmer, Aysheh Al-Khawaja, Bayan Sheikh Ali, Shahed Al-atiyat, Rahaf Turab, Rana Elmalahi, Ala’aldin Eqleem, Sumaiah Alnaimat, Ahmad BanyAmer, Marwa Alshatti, Zaid Omari, Mohammad Abu Shattal
pmc-12752286.description: BackgroundUp to 15% of NSCLC cases arise in never-smokers, and an additional subset arises in light smokers. Data on these groups in the Middle East are limited. Therefore, we compared the clinicopathological features, survival, and molecular alterations in never and light smokers with stage IV NSCLC treated at a tertiary center in Jordan.

pmc-13084627.title: Three-Electrode, 3D-Printed NMR Cells for Electrooxidation Studies
pmc-13084627.creator: Sara A. Salout, Leonid Shupletsov, Irena Senkovska, Arafat H. Khan, Stefan Kaskel, Eike Brunner
pmc-13084627.description: This study describes a novel experimental apparatus for monitoring electrochemical reactions by in situ NMR spectroscopy. A unique cylindrical 3D-printed electrochemical cell, incorporating a reference electrode, was developed to enable electrochemical measurements through exact potential control. The performance of the novel cell is demonstrated by monitoring ethanol electrooxidation, an important process in fuel cell technology.

pmc-13198539.title: Exosomal ORF3a mediates lung-liver axis to dysregulate hepatic lipid metabolism in mild COVID-19
pmc-13198539.creator: Yafei Qu, Jinglin Zhou, Xinjia Wang, Shupeng Dong, Jingjiao Li, Lingxi Qiu, Lu Bian, Weiming Yuan, Qing Xie, Jieming Qu, Zhen Zhao, Xianfang Wu, Qiming Liang
pmc-13198539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). While SARS-CoV-2 primarily infects the respiratory tract, it can also damage other organs, including the liver, during both acute infection and long COVID1. Liver involvement significantly increases the severity and mortality rate of COVID-192. Although studies have shown that the virus can directly infect the liver cells in severe or fatal cases, it typically remains confined to the lungs in mild infections3. Therefore, the mechanisms by which mild COVID-19 causes liver damage and metabolic disruption remain unclear.

pmc-13455157.creator: Vignesh Vivekanandam, Anurag Singla, Hemant Goel, Ashish Varshney, Nishok Raj
pmc-13455157.description: IntroductionResidual stone fragments following ureteroscopic lithotripsy (URSL) contribute to stone recurrence, UTI, and the need for repeat procedures. Identifying preoperative predictors of incomplete stone clearance is essential for optimizing surgical planning and patient counselling. We aimed to evaluate clinical, stone-related, and operative predictors of residual fragments after URSL for upper and mid-ureteric calculi.
